Book Now

Before I ever picked up a camera, I was a painter.

Composition, light, and rhythm have always guided the way I see the world. Photography became my medium not because I wanted to capture moments, but because I wanted to preserve feeling — the kind that transcends time.

Over the years, I’ve had the honor of documenting love stories across continents — from windswept coastal vows in Portugal to candlelit soirées in the heart of Paris. Each couple, each celebration, becomes a living canvas: a study in intimacy, elegance, and meaning.

My work has been described as romantic yet restrained, cinematic yet sincere. It’s my hope that, decades from now, your images will not only remind you of how your wedding looked — but how it felt.
